# frozen_string_literal: true
# Ruby の見本
require 'json'
require_relative './helper'

module Geo
  class Point < Struct.new(:x, :y)
    include Comparable
    attr_reader :label
    DEFAULT = { x: 0, 'y' => 1.5e-3 }.freeze

    def initialize(x = 0, y = 0, label: nil, **opts, &blk)
      super(x, y)
      @label = label || "p#{x},#{y}"
      @@count ||= 0
      $stderr.puts "init #{self.class.name}" if $DEBUG
    end

    def <=>(other) = x <=> other.x

    def self.parse(str)
      return nil unless str =~ /\A(\d+),(\d+)\z/i
      new($1.to_i, $2.to_i)
    end

    private

    def each_pair
      [[:x, x], [:y, y]].each { |k, v| yield k, v }
    end
  end
end

points = %w[a b c].map.with_index(1) { |s, i| Geo::Point.new(i, i * 2, label: s) }
squares = (1..10).select(&:even?).to_h { |n| [n, n**2] }
case points.first
in { x: Integer => px } if px > 0 then puts px
else puts :none
end

  heredoc #{sym.inspect}
HEREDOC
